events.title: Next Fest Update - Introducing Special Requests
events.summary: Ahead of Steam Next Fest, we have pushed one final update!New special request featureFeedback:If you have any feedback, a reply to this post or the new in game feedback button can be used to give feedback. Any feedback will be taken into account for the full game release!

events.title: Demo Update & Feedback Request - New Wardrobe Freature
events.summary: CHANGELOG:NEW WARDROBE feature, allows the player to customize their characterDancer fidelity improved with higher resolution normal and skin texturesDancer fidelity improved with the addition of contact shadowsTutorial beacon now fades as the player approaches, allowing easier sight through Tutorial waypoint moved to more accurately reflect the location of the object the player is being instructed to interact withFEEDBACK:In order to continue improving Nightlife we are asking for any player fee
